bugfix.area: Inner P02/native owner callback identity boundary
bugfix.problem: Top-level NoxPackHost pinned Windows SID/session_lease, but nested P02 chat/attachment/voice/SIP callback scope guards compared only tenant/principal/chat_id/permissions. Callbacks could rotate SID or session lease without changing those five fields, allowing stream event or backend call before the outer post-return check.
bugfix.implementation: One private _native_owner_scope helper captures full 7-element scope. Rechecked after P02 history callback, on each stream chunk before event publication and after event sink, between message writes, after file picker and store; voice identity before microphone capture, after capture and after owner call; SIP identity before quote, after quote and after owner call. The existing host50 catalog/owner/risk, dangerous fresh native consent, session revocation verifier, E11 preview/STOP remain byte-identical.
bugfix.limitations: A mutated SID/lease is now detected at inner side-effect boundaries. Native logout/revocation without tuple mutation requires live host callback and owner pre-effect checks; outer post-return denial cannot roll back physical calls or side effects. Native Windows validation still pending.

errors_and_lessons.applied_prior_lesson: Used exact pinned G6-B preimage rather than mutable B5 live donor and required readback of every seven-field owner scope guard; did not trust replacement count alone.
errors_and_lessons.new_error: Inner P02 callbacks had a narrower identity tuple than outer NoxPackHost; stale SID/lease could survive nested pre-effect checks.
errors_and_lessons.new_lesson: Authorization checked only at dispatcher entry and exit is insufficient for streaming, microphone or SIP callbacks. Every nested owner boundary must recheck the exact native Windows SID and lease immediately BEFORE sensitive side effects; put rechecks before emitting streamed deltas, not merely after.
errors_and_lessons.prevention: Reuse one seven-field immutable-scope function for all nested P02 boundaries, validate before/after callbacks, add future actual Python regression where test path owner grant and a checkout exist, and keep physical native/effect-side STOP gates HOLD without Windows evidence.
